findings.summary: Every subagent session.start with an agentId is recorded as a background agent, including foreground subagents (developer, reviewers) that finish inside the turn with no end event. endBackgroundAgent removes at most one agent per parent turn.start, so with N foreground subagents in one turn N-1 or more stay in state.agents. After the final turn.complete, executorBoardState returns background-agent-running instead of idle-awaiting-clear, a stuck value DEC-0392 part 2 would read as busy. Fix: clear agents on turn.complete when no background launch is known, or only record agents flagged as background, or clear all on any non-notification parent turn.start; add a test with several foreground agents.

findings.summary: Round-1 finding 1 is fixed for the foreground case. A subagent's own turn.complete now removes it, and the new three-foreground-agents test passes. The fix goes too far the other way: any parent turn.start without 'task-notification' in e.text/e.prompt now clears ALL agents, including a background agent still running. Example: a developer is backgrounded and a dispatch enqueue or operator message starts an ordinary parent turn; the board then publishes turn-running and later idle-awaiting-clear while the developer still works. DEC-0392 part 2 would read that as idle. Same if the host's turn.start carries no text (not confirmed): the first notification clears every agent and two concurrent agents are no longer tracked separately (AC2). Suggest keeping agents on a non-notification turn, or clearing only agents whose turn.complete was seen. At minimum confirm the host's turn.start payload.
